_comment: DOIs of Daniel's papers that are missing from his ORCID record, which is otherwise the spine of this pipeline (see fetch-data.mjs section 1). Everything else about them (title, journal, authors, citations) still comes from Crossref and OpenAlex. Add a DOI here to make a paper appear immediately; the better long-term fix is to add the work to ORCID, after which the entry here is harmless but redundant.

dois.10.1017/rsm.2026.10108: Nakagawa et al. 2026, Research Synthesis Methods. Published online 28 Sep 2026; not on ORCID as of 7 Oct 2026 (Daniel flagged it missing from the site).
